about.what: A short, AI-written summary of today's dashboard data (markets, economy, rates, UK, sentiment, positioning) and clustered news headlines.
about.why: It turns dozens of panels into a two-minute read: what moved, what it may mean for the cycle, and which stories are driving it.
about.how_to_read: The pipeline builds a compact digest of the published numbers and asks a free LLM (Gemini, Groq as fallback) to narrate it. An automatic fact check then requires every number to match the digest exactly, with the right unit, the right direction (rose/fell) and the right metric (e.g. a number after 'core CPI' must be core CPI). It also rejects advice words (buy, sell, should…) and any regime name other than the computed one. A failing answer is sent back once with the errors, then the next provider is tried; if all fail, the previous summary is kept and marked stale. Treat it as a reading aid, not a forecast. Not investment advice.

brief.headline: Jensen Huang's Return Sparks Tech Rally and Massive Stock Gains
bullets: The S&P 500 rose 4.7% as markets surged following executive leadership changes.
The Nasdaq 100 rose 7.0% alongside broad-based technology sector strength.
The US 10Y Yield rose 1 bp to 4.92% as inflation metrics remained in focus.
brief.what_moved: Equities advanced sharply led by the Nasdaq 100 rising 7.0% and the S&P 500 rising 4.7%, while the VIX fell 25.8% to a level of 26.62. Commodities and alternative assets saw minor declines, with Gold falling 0.7% to a level of 3624.4 and Bitcoin falling 1.2% to a level of 60435.44.
brief.cycle_view: The macro regime sits in a boundary state near Goldilocks with no clear growth or inflation momentum. Real GDP YoY is decelerating, while core CPI YoY and core PCE YoY remain flat. Equities have historically tended to outperform bonds, commodities and cash in this phase, and cyclical and growth sectors have historically tended to lead defensive sectors.
